SIX deck-paired cells on ONE band and the SAME 400 decks: fair PIMC candidate at k4x200=800 / k4x400=1600 / k4x688=2752 / k4x1376=5504 / k8x1376=11008 under fixed_v1, plus W2752 = the k4x688 cell re-run under rules_profile walled with R9 OFF; all six vs the FROZEN clairvoyant HeuristicMCTS(h800, c=3.0, leaf 42af12fce22e1a0f). PRIMARY = the within-band deck-paired rung SPACINGS (Delta1..Delta4 and SPAN = R_11008 - R_800) in pts/game; DELIVERABLE = the five re-based rung absolutes R_i; ATTRIBUTION = A = M_C2752 - M_W2752, the rules-only axis.
rows.notes: Owner FUNDED 2026-08-23: 'I'm funding both', ~118.8 core-h, DESIGN.md Section 0.1. Band substituted from the draft's 142000000000 -> 145000000000 at freeze (DESIGN.md Section 0.5): the draft's band and its reserved successor were BOTH already claimed and retired by an unrelated concurrent track (CARCASUM RATED MATCH rung 1 / RUNG-2 BUDGET LADDER) by freeze time, and 144000000000 is spoken for on the unmerged d2r2-freeze branch -- 145000000000 is clear of all of that. Seeds 145000000000..145000000399 (400 decks x 2 seatings = 800 games PER CELL, 4,800 games total across six cells; ONE deck set shared by ALL SIX). CRN across the six cells is DELIBERATE: per CL-068 the within-band deck-paired contrast is the ROBUST class, so the rung SPACINGS and the attribution statistic A -- not the absolutes -- are what this band is claimed to measure, and BOTH carry NO cross-band tax. The cross-era deltas against the July F5 fair_ruler_* cells (band 24e9, python backend, pre-fixed_v1 rules) are CROSS-BAND AND CROSS-ERA and carry the mandatory CL-068 2x sigma inflation (2-sigma MDE approximately 62 elo); they exist at only THREE of the five rungs (2752, 5504, 11008) because the 800 and 1600 rungs have no same-allocation post-fix comparator anywhere in the repo -- those two rungs produce NEW ABSOLUTES. The bundled W2752 cell resolves the RULES axis of that era bundle to approximately 24 elo within-band at one rung; the residual is a leftover, never an estimate of the band effect. This band is NOT to be pooled with 15e9 (CL-046 G1), 24e9 (F5 G2), 141e9 (D2, U-UNREADABLE), 142e9/143e9 (CARCASUM), or 144e9 (D2-R2). The DESIGN Section 9 pilot uses a DISJOINT throwaway seed range, 145999999000..145999999007 (8 decks, run TWICE -- once fixed_v1, once walled), discarded, never pooled, never itself claimed as a row. Band identity is load-bearing per CLAUDE.md and this band retires from confirmatory use once it has influenced a decision.
